testId: tests/webstore/CartCheckoutPage/CartCheckoutPageTest.spec.ts > SAN-012 SAN-022 EDG-005 EDG-002 EDG-011 EDG-020 SAN-035 EDG-001: No price, tax or shipping cost on the page

scenario.summary: As a created Sales Rep (Shop As) with three allotted sizes and two saved addresses (NJ default, CA), the combined page never shows a price, subtotal, tax, shipping cost, total or estimate shipping section, in visible text or in the DOM including hidden elements, for one or three lines, after a quantity edit, address changes, a new address and a refresh.
steps: Sign in on the storefront (config webstoreURL, /login) with the tester's own Admin account (config adminUsername / adminPassword, from env ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD); the Web Admin Dashboard (/admin) opens
In Web Admin open Users, find the created Sales Rep by its user name (@user.userName) and choose Shop As; the storefront opens as that user with the impersonation header
Open the PDP /product/{@product.parentProductId}; the size grid is shown
Enter 1 for size @product.variant1Attr1 and click Add to Cart; open the Header Cart and scan the page with one line (EDG-001 step 1-2)
On the PDP enter 2 for @product.variant2Attr1 and 5 for @product.variant3Attr1 and click Redeem Now; the Order Summary lists three lines with 1, 2 and 5 (EDG-005 step 1, SAN-012 step 1)
Review every Order Summary line, Delivery, Address and Contact and the area around Place Order (SAN-012 steps 2-4, SAN-022 steps 2-3, EDG-005 step 3)
Scan the visible page text (the text a select-all copy would give) and the DOM including hidden (display:none) elements for the price terms (EDG-002, EDG-011 steps 1-3, SAN-035 step 4)
Check there is no Estimate Shipping section, zip estimate field or estimated amount (SAN-035)
Check Delivery shows the default shipping method (SAN-022 step 4; see P4)
Change the quantity of @product.variant1Sku from 1 to 2 in the Order Summary and scan again (EDG-005 step 2, SAN-035 step 3)
In Address and Contact select @addressNj, scan; select @addressCa, scan (EDG-020 steps 2-4, SAN-035 step 3)
Add a new address in New York (created by the test, a valid US address that passes Loqate) and scan again (EDG-020 step 5)
Refresh and scan again; Delivery shows the same method (SAN-022 step 5)
stateChanges: The Sales Rep user, its three allotments and its two addresses are created for the test by their collections and deleted at teardown
Cart lines (1, 2, 5; first line edited to 2)
A new NY address typed by the test (created-by-test values; removed with the user)
assertions: No currency amount ($ followed by a number), 'Subtotal', 'Tax', 'Shipping cost', 'Total', 'Estimate Shipping', 'Free' or '$0.00' is shown in the visible text, at any point
No price, subtotal, tax or shipping cost element exists in the DOM, including hidden elements
No Estimate Shipping Cost section, estimate field or estimated amount is shown
After the quantity edit no recalculated price or total appears
After selecting each saved address and after adding a new address no tax, shipping cost, subtotal or price appears
After refresh the page still shows no prices and Delivery shows the same shipping method (method name: P4)
evidence: Jira BMP-94 (story, FSD section 'Shopping Cart and Checkout', work/stories/BMP-94/input/) and manual cases SAN-012, SAN-022, EDG-005, EDG-002, EDG-011, EDG-020, SAN-035, EDG-001 (work/stories/BMP-94/input/BMP-94-testcases.md)

work/stories/BMP-94/analysis.md section 6: every role test signs in with the tester's own Admin account and reaches the created user through Shop As (user decision 2026-11-26); created users never sign in with a password, so 'signed in as <role>' in the cases is reached through Shop As

PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_SIZE_GRID (existing BNJM size-grid products, no price rule: BNJM variants are priced 0.00; user decision 2026-11-27) replaces the hardcoded /product/798 (BM05) and size Small of the cases; on qa product 798 (SKU BM05) is configured by attribute Size (ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute -> PimAttributeId 129, AttributeCode Size), so variantAttributes = Size

Allotments: BIWW Allocations custom table, linked to the rep only by SalesRepEmail (analysis section 9); one ALLOTMENT_OF_USER_FOR_VARIANT need per variant the test enters, quantity = the highest quantity the test reaches for it

Delivery method: the expected method name and information wait for a read-only key of store BNJM's default shipping method (P4, not built: where Admin stores the default on BNJM is unknown, analysis section 9). Until it exists the test checks the heading 'Delivery', that one shipping method with its information is shown and that no cost or price wording is shown, not which method it is

Precondition 'Show Estimate Shipping Cost Section = No, published' waits for a read-only key of the store attribute ShowEstimateShippingCost (P5, not built; qa value is false today, analysis section 9)

Partially automated: EDG-001 20 lines and a product priced 0.00 are not coverable yet (no key; PRODUCT_SIMPLE_WITHOUT_PRICE is a simple product without a price); EDG-011 step 4 print preview is manual; SAN-022 'configured heading' is BMP-500 (no attribute); SAN-022 'a second product with quantity 2' is not coverable yet: a second need of the same product key can resolve to the same product (question to the user); SAN-012 step 5 (Admin) is in the SAN-017 test
EDG-005 step 4 (user without a saved address) is in the EDG-005 SAN-028 SAN-030 EDG-015 test

Not covered (test author report on the spec (framework branch dev_BMP94, 75b25168, 2026-11-27)): EDG-001 20 line items and the product priced $0.00 (no key yet); EDG-011 print preview (manual only); SAN-022 second product and the heading clause (BMP-500); SAN-035 steps 1-2 (Admin setting change and publish) - partially automated
